content.content: The entry reads the process working directory to anchor resolution; if it cannot be read, "." is substituted and resolution proceeds — root-less when no workspace resolves (S3-root-optional) — so only a genuine resolution failure surfaces through the ordinary resolution path — a refusal — rather than a panic or a cause the entry authors itself.
content.rationale: The entry's job is to hand the resolver a working directory; an unreadable one is not a failure the entry should author. Substituting "." keeps the read total (S3-err's no-panic rule) and lets resolution proceed, so the entry authors no cause of its own and a genuine failure still surfaces as a refusal (M-resolution-failure) — one failure surface, not two.
